The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.

Regarding the evaluation of the provided text: The text describes a press release from CarMakers Inc. claiming a 600-mile range for a new electric vehicle. The evidence provided is of low quality and low relevance to any objective verification of the claim. The text explicitly states that the company cites "proprietary research" but fails to share the research methodology, sample sizes, or comparisons to existing vehicles. This lack of transparency and verifiable data makes the claim unsubstantiated and unreliable.
